findings: Dead i18n keys: molecules.expand and molecules.collapse exist in both ar.json and en.json but have no call site after the accordion dropped its aria-label; remove them from both locales or wire them to a visible control.

Radio role vs toggle semantics: SelectableCard sets role="radio" but handles only Enter/Space toggle, with no radiogroup container or arrow-key roving; document that consumers must supply the group semantics, or default the role to one the single-element behavior satisfies.
Pagination has no truncation: it renders one button per page for the full pageCount, so a large count yields an unbounded row; add ellipsis/windowing before adopting it on a page with many pages.

Navbar surface deviates from Figma fill: bg-card/80 + backdrop-blur-sm instead of the solid #fafafa the Figma node specifies; confirm the translucent sticky treatment is intended or switch to the solid fill.
Bundled unrelated CI change: the uncommitted .github/workflows/ci.yml edit adds a Next typegen step before typecheck; land it as its own commit rather than riding along with stage 4A.
